A newline inside two nested spans after an emphasis still separates the words on either side

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p><i>Alpha</i><span><span>\n</span></span>Beta</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
